endpoints.POST /verify-receipt: verification receipt -> validity (+ optional bundle digest check, optional revocations)
endpoints.POST /verify-anchor: OpenTimestamps detached proof + digest + header(s) -> proof status
endpoints.POST /anchors: store an OTS proof for a digest (keyed)
endpoints.POST /conformance: grade a verifier submission over the pinned corpus -> signed conformance report
endpoints.POST /payment-receipts: internal: sign + store a content-free settlement receipt (X-Internal-Token)
endpoints.GET /revocations/<issuer>: stored revocation document for an issuer (keyless)
endpoints.POST /erc8004/validate: Derive an outcome from the core verifier verdict and task binding; issuer policy is not evaluated and anchors are not required. Returns an Ed25519-signed canonical JSON statement; this service does not relay it onchain.
endpoints.POST /crystals: store sealed Memory Crystal ciphertext (2 MiB max; ChaCha20-Poly1305 / AES-256-GCM)
endpoints.GET /crystals/owner-locator: authenticated bootstrap; return the owner locator assigned by the gateway registry
endpoints.GET /crystals/<id>: fetch a crystal in the authenticated owner's scope
endpoints.GET /crystals/lineage: fetch lineage in the authenticated owner's scope
endpoints.POST /notarize: sign caller-supplied context/prompt digests and bounded claims; service does not observe the underlying context or execution

verification_receipt.requested_with: ?receipt=1 on POST /verify, or receipt: true on MCP verify_bundle
verification_receipt.digest_rule: sha256 of the JCS-canonical bytes of the verified bundle object
verification_receipt.consistency: error_codes equals the codes in errors; verdict equals the class implied by the errors/reasons
verification_receipt.verify_offline: signature over JCS canonical bytes minus sig; use a compatible continuity-receipt implementation and check /info for the running verifier version and supported specs

conformance.submission: implementation metadata + verifier outputs over the pinned corpus; build one with tools/conformance_submit.py

erc8004.checks: The core verdict and task binding drive the outcome. chain_integrity, signatures_valid, resource_caps_respected, issuer policy, and anchor status are not reported as per-check successes by this adapter; their check fields are null. termination_present only checks for a receipts-list item with type exactly task.termination.
erc8004.issuer_policy: Not evaluated: no relying-party issuer allowlist or consumer profile is applied.
erc8004.anchors: Not required for the adapter outcome; no independent anchor status is reported. The core verifier may inspect supplied anchor evidence.
erc8004.attestation: Ed25519 signature over a canonical JSON message; no EVM-compatible signature or onchain relay is performed by this service.

crystals.isolation: candidate routes derive storage scope from an authenticated gateway assertion mapped through the explicit owner registry; legacy ownerless data must be quarantined
crystals.access_model: all crystal reads and writes require an authenticated owner assertion; GET /crystals/owner-locator returns the registry-mapped locator; no first-reader ownership claim
crystals.envelope_compatibility: wm-crystal/1.0 envelope/AAD retained; new clients may bootstrap and use the registry locator; legacy public-salt locators are not automatically migrated
crystals.assertion_replay: SQLite nonce ledger is persistent across API restarts and shared across worker processes; nonce is retained through exp plus clock-skew allowance
crystals.assertion_key_rotation: keyring carries active_kid and keys; issuer uses active_kid, verifier accepts retained overlap keys until removed

digest_cache.stores: digest + verdict payload in memory only; never on disk

privacy: POST /verify evaluates bundles in memory and does not store or log them. Persistent data also includes revocation documents, hosted anchors, payment receipts, caller-claim notarizations, sealed crystals, assertion replay nonces, and the service signing key. Crystal routes require an authenticated owner assertion; legacy ownerless crystals remain quarantined until an explicit operator mapping is established. ?cache=1 opts into an in-memory digest->verdict cache.
